title: Omit Write-on-Lines After Questions

illustrates.quote: Omit lines, dashes, circles, boxes, or other print devices printed before or after questions, indicating where students are to answer questions.

blocks.text: Follow your teacher’s instructions to answer the following questions about "The Lorelei."
A write-on-line follows each question in print; omitted per 10.5.1.

braille.notes: Independently re-extracted from source (fixed left margin / line-number field stripped by counting; U+2800→space; trailing spaces removed); confirmed byte-identical to both run A and run B (gold-10-A/gold-10-B) except where differences.md records a correction.

resolution: Braille matches both A and B exactly. Print unchanged from A/B; the poem-excerpt title is built as a genuine centred heading since the given braille centres it on its own line.
